summary: Iter39: Design unification across 7 secondary public pages (Nosotros, Eventos, DatosEstadisticas, Noticias, Contacto, Login, TeamRegister) + CMS extension with 29 new editable fields. Backend (3/3 tests pass) and frontend (all 7 pages + admin + CMS flow + navbar + home regression) fully working.

issues: Default value is 'temporada' (backend) but problem statement mentions 'temporada 2026'. Field is editable via CMS so easy to override; flag as minor copy mismatch only.

Computed fontFamily on <nav> root resolves to 'Barlow, Inter, sans-serif' (parent layer). Link children may apply Agency FB via class. Navbar is identical across all non-home pages (same 8 links, same look). If Agency FB is required on the nav element itself, main agent can verify visually.

results.test_home_settings_has_29_new_fields: PASS - All 29 new fields present with non-empty defaults
results.test_put_persists_and_revert: PASS - PUT nosotros_hero_body='Test custom body iter39' persists; GET returns new value; revert succeeds

frontend_tests_executed./nosotros pills: PASS - [data-testid=nosotros-pill-1..4] all use Agency FB family; defaults visible: 'Reglamento claro', '4 partidos mínimo', 'Datos en vivo', 'Familia FSC' with correct body texts.
frontend_tests_executed./datos-estadisticas hero: PASS - [data-testid=estadisticas-hero-title] renders 'estadisticas' (accent stripped, lowercase) with Plane Crash.
frontend_tests_executed./contacto hero: PASS - [data-testid=contacto-hero-title] renders 'contacto' with Plane Crash. Form section title 'envianos tu consulta' renders with Plane Crash.
frontend_tests_executed./registro-equipo: PASS - [data-testid=tr-title] renders 'registra tu club' with Plane Crash.
frontend_tests_executed.hablemos block: PASS - [data-testid=hablemos-title] renders 'hablemos' with Plane Crash on /nosotros.
frontend_tests_executed./admin/home sections: PASS - All 6 sections found: NOSOTROS (PÁGINA), EVENTOS (PÁGINA), ESTADÍSTICAS (PÁGINA), NOTICIAS (PÁGINA), CONTACTO (PÁGINA), BLOQUE 'HABLEMOS' (NOSOTROS + CONTACTO).
frontend_tests_executed.CMS->page flow: PASS - PUT nosotros_pill_1_title='TEST Reglamento iter39' via /api/home-settings (admin cookie), /nosotros [data-testid=nosotros-pill-1] reflects the new title; revert to 'Reglamento claro' verified on UI.
frontend_tests_executed.navbar consistency: PASS - Same 8 links (INICIO, NOSOTROS, EVENTOS, ESTADÍSTICAS, NOTICIAS, CONTÁCTO, ADMIN, FUTURSOCCERCUP-wordmark) on /nosotros, /eventos, /contacto.
frontend_tests_executed.home regression: PASS - 'edicion', 'somos mas', 'finales' all render with Plane Crash family on /. No JS pageerrors observed across all 7 pages.

action_items: Optional: align Eventos hero_kicker default to 'temporada 2026' if the spec text is the source of truth (currently 'temporada').
Optional: confirm whether the global <Navbar> root element should expose Agency FB at computed-style level (children currently rely on inherited utility classes).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminHomeSettings Field inputs don't expose name/id/data-testid — the CMS works correctly but UI automated testing of individual fields has to rely on label text matching. Consider adding data-testid (e.g., field-nosotros_pill_1_title) for robustness in future iter tests.
planeCrashSafe() correctly normalizes lowercase + strips diacritics (used consistently across all pages, verified by rendered text 'nosotros', 'estadisticas', 'envianos').
designSystem.js centralized successfully; all 7 pages import from it. No local font constant duplicates detected.
seed_data_creation: Transient PUT of nosotros_pill_1_title='TEST Reglamento iter39' and nosotros_hero_body='Test custom body iter39' — both reverted to their original defaults at end of test run. home_settings doc restored to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter39 unified the design system. Key conventions: lowercase grunge via planeCrashSafe(); 5 fonts in /app/frontend/src/lib/designSystem.js (PLANE_CRASH, AGENCY_FB, NEO_SANS, STENCIL, CURSIVE); 5 official colors (RED #e31f27, BLUE #0640c8, BLACK, WHITE, GRAY #dedfe0). 29 new editable home_settings fields exposed via /admin/home (route /admin/home, NOT /admin/configuracion-home). Admin AdminHomeSettings uses generic <Field /> wrapper without name/testid — automate via label text or directly via PUT /api/home-settings.
